meta.title: An awarded event: "Convert to Auction" is greyed out and says why

plan.title: Awarded Event Convert to Auction Disabled

steps.note: Open the prepared awarded event on its RFQ Responses view.
Assert that Convert to Auction is present but greyed out and that its explanatory tooltip is shown.
Reopen the RFQ Settings menu so the disabled item can be clicked directly.
Verify that clicking the greyed-out item opens no dialog, page, or conversion flow.
